Combat Director '''Ss'ess''' was a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] who, for a time, guided [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] through [[Nickel One]] after [[Osos Niskooen|Niskooen]] was killed. Ss'ess was killed along with other Verpines when the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] released a [[Nanovirus|nanokiller]] onto the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].
